provider.title: Single sign-on
provider.intro: People linked to the identity provider sign in through it only. The provider is set by the server operator (LAKANA_OIDC__ISSUER), so it is shown here and changed there.
provider.name: Provider
provider.oneLeft: Only one administrator can still sign in with a passkey. Keep at least one, so a provider outage cannot lock everyone out.
provider.noneLeft: No administrator can sign in with a passkey. Add a passkey for one, or unlink one, so a provider outage cannot lock everyone out.

window.label: Token window in days
window.help: The personal API tokens of a linked person work for this long after their last sign-in through the identity provider. Between {{min}} and {{max}} days.
window.outOfBounds: The token window is between {{min}} and {{max}} days. Enter a whole number in that range.
